title: PCA from Scratch: Eigendecomposition and SVD
summary: Implement principal component analysis two ways, eigendecomposing the covariance matrix and taking the SVD of the centered data, with a deterministic sign convention, explained variance ratios, projection and reconstruction, and a rule for choosing k.

ShapeMismatch.hint: Components are rows of shape (k, d). Project with Xc @ components.T to get (n, k), and reconstruct with Z @ components to get back (n, d).

hints.test_center_and_covariance_match_numpy: Subtract the column means, then Xc.T @ Xc / (n − 1). Dividing by n gives the biased estimate, which doesn't match np.cov.
hints.test_covariance_requires_two_samples: With n = 1 the n − 1 denominator is 0. Check the number of rows first and raise ValueError.
hints.test_pca_eigh_sorted_descending: np.linalg.eigh returns eigenvalues in ascending order. Reorder with np.argsort(evals)[::-1] and reorder the eigenvector columns the same way.
hints.test_pca_eigh_components_and_sign_conven: Eigenvectors are columns of the eigh output, so transpose to rows. An eigenvector's sign is arbitrary: multiply each row by the sign of its largest-magnitude entry.
hints.test_pca_is_shift_invariant: Adding a constant to every row must not change the components. If it does, something isn't centering the data first, often the SVD path.
hints.test_pca_svd_matches_eigh: SVD of the centered data: Xc = U S Vᵀ. Rows of Vᵀ are the components and S² / (n − 1) are the variances. Apply the same sign flip.
hints.test_explained_variance_ratio: Divide each explained variance by the total variance, which is the trace of the covariance matrix (all d components), not just the k you kept.
hints.test_transform_inverse_roundtrip: transform: (X − mean_) @ components_.T. inverse_transform: Z @ components_ + mean_. Use the mean learned in fit, not the mean of the new data.
hints.test_choose_k: Take np.cumsum of the ratios and return the first position (1-based) where it reaches the threshold. Reject thresholds outside (0, 1].
hints.test_inputs_not_mutated: Build new arrays (X - mean, components * signs) instead of using in-place operators like -= or *= on the inputs.
